Commentary.Commentary: Once Sikandar Raza was dismissed, Zimbabwe kept losing wickets. Ervine failed to get into three figures as well but somehow the hosts managed to cross the 250-run mark. For West Indies, Carlos Brathwaite was the pick of the bowlers as he picked four wickets in his 10-over spell. Gabriel and Holder picked up two each towards the end and didn't let Zimbabwe to cross 300 which looked certain at one stage. The wicket looks good to bat on so let's see how West Indies reply. Join us back in a bit for the run chase.

The wickets towards the end have hurt Zimbabwe but still they've managed to post a decent total on the board here. West Indies were unable to get the early breakthrough and a mix-up between the openers resulted in a wicket. Chari soon followed his partner and then there was a big partnership between Sikandar Raza and Craig Ervine. The duo added 144 runs for the third wicket and smashed fifties each.

OUT! MIDDLE STUMP BROKEN! Fuller length ball around off, Mpofu tries to hit it over the leg side but misses. The ball goes through and crashes onto the middle stump and its top half is broken! Best ever bowling figures for Carlos Brathwaite in ODIs! Zimbabwe are all out for 257 in exactly 50 overs.
Fuller length ball around off, Mpofu works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish outside off, Mpofu drives it back to the bowler.
Chris Mpofu is the last man in.
OUT! Straight into the hands! Cremer gets across and tries to paddle this full toss but only manages to play it straight to Gabriel at short fine leg. Another wicket for Carlos!
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Fuller length ball around off, Cremer drives it back to the bowler.
Tendai Chisoro walks in next.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Fuller length ball on off, Tiripano goes for a big shot but misses it completely. The ball goes through and uproots the middle stump. Gabriel picks up his second wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE! Cremer gets across and Gabriel bowls it wide outside off. Cremer misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller length ball on the pads, Tiripano flicks it through the backward square leg region for a single.
SIX! What a shot! Landed around off, Tiripano comes down the track and smokes it down the ground for a biggie all the way. 250 up for Zimbabwe. This is also their highest score in 2016.
Shortish outside off, Tiripano pulls it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Yorker around leg stump, Tiripano digs it out solidly.
Driven through covers for a single.
Shortish outside off, cut away through point for a couple.
Shortish on off, Cremer hammers it to long on for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, Cremer tries to play it across but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Full on the pads, Cremer drives it through mid on for a couple.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tiripano gets a thick outside edge. The short third man fielder goes to his left and cuts it off. Single taken!
Carlos Brathwaite is back.
Very full outside off, Cremer looks to squeeze it out but misses.
Shortish on off, hit hard to wide long on for a couple.
Short of a length ball outside off, Tiripano plays it through backward point for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Donald Tiripano is the next man in.

OUT! Ervine departs! Misses out on a well-deserving ton! Fuller length ball, it's the slower one, it stops a bit and Ervine tries to hit it across. The ball goes off the leading edge and Powell runs in from wide long on and takes the catch. Ervine has to go. Wonderful knock comes to an end.
Flicked through the mid-wicket region by Cremer for a single.
FOUR! Fuller length ball on off, Ervine drives it down the ground for a boundary. Well played!
Graeme Cremer walks in next.

OUT! Another incredible catch! Back of a length ball on off, Moor tries to hammer it over mid-wicket but gets a top edge. The ball flies over the keeper's head and Powell runs to his left from short third man and takes a brilliant catch diving forward. Moor departs and Holder gets another wicket.
Full on the pads, worked away to fine leg for a single.
Fuller length ball around off, Moor drives it through mid on for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Moor goes for the pull but misses it completely.
Low full toss around off, driven through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Moor lofts it over mid off. The fielder is inside the circle and PJ Moor gets a boundary.
Banged in short, Moor lets it go over him.
Yorker on off, Ervine taps it to covers for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Moor drives it through covers for a single.
Yorker on off, Moor digs it out.
Full on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Gabriel is back.
Short of a length ball on off, Moor drops his wrists and lets it go through but the ball goes off his chest and to the keeper behind. West Indies appeal but there was no bat involved.
Landed outside off, Moor pushes it to covers.
Peter Moor walks in next.

OUT! Edged and gone! Fuller length ball outside off, Chigumbura clears his front leg and tries to smoke it down the ground. But only manages to get an outside edge to the keeper behind. Doesn't even wait for the umpire's signal and starts walking. Holder gets his first, Zimbabwe slip further.
Banged in short on off, Chigumbura ducks under it.
Attemps a yorker but dishes out a full toss, played through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Ervine tries to dig it out but misses it.
Landed outside off, driven through mid off for a couple.
On middle and leg, Ervine works it away through wide mid on for a single.
Landed outside off, Ervine goes for the reverse sweep but misses it completely.
On the pads, Chigumbura sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Full toss on off, Ervine goes for the sweep and ends up playing it towards backward square leg. Single taken.
Fullish on off, Chigumbura drives it through mid off for a single.
Landed outside off, Ervine drives it through extra cover for a couple.

FOUR! This is poor fielding! Fuller length ball outside off, Ervine drives it towards extra cover. Carter puts in a dive there but only manages to parry it towards mid off. In fact the mid off runs to his right but since Carter has parried the ball, he has no chance to stop it too now. Ervine gets a boundary.
Landed around off, Ervine flicks it away to the leg side.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chigumbura drives it through mid off for a single.
Angles it on the pads, Ervine works it to fine leg for a single.
Yorker outside off, Ervine digs it out.
Jason Holder is back.
Around off, Chigumbura defends it into the ground.

Landed outside off, Chigumbura plays it towards point. The fielder collects the ball and fires in a throw at the striker's end but misses his shy. The ball goes towards the rope but Lewis fielding there does well to stop the ball. Two runs taken in the end.
Played to mid-wicket region by Ervine. One run added to the total.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Ervine tries to clip but misses.
Shortish outside off, cut away through point for a single.
Landed outside off, spins away a touch, Elton tries to defend but misses it completely.
Tossed up ball outside off, Ervine drives it through mid off for a single.
Sulieman Benn back on.
Powerplay 3 time! Five fielders are allowed outside the circle now.
Tossed up on off, Chigumbura pushes it to covers.
Elton Chigumbura walks in next.

OUT! LBW! Nicely bowled, around the off stump channel, Williams tries to sweep this one but misses and gets hit on the pads. Big appeal for a leg before and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. It looked dead plumb. Zimbabwe lose a quick wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
DROPPED! Landed outside off, Ervine smacks it hard down the ground. Nurse simply tries to stop the ball to his right but fails to. It could have been a stunning catch.
Shortish outside off, Ervine slaps it through covers for a couple.
Flatter outside off, Ervine fails to put his bat on the ball.
Short of a length ball on off, Williams pulls it through square leg for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Ervine misses his flick.
Sean Williams walks in next.

OUT! Raza holes out! Fuller length ball outside off, Raza tries to loft it down the ground, somewhere near long off but doesn't time it that well. The ball goes high up in the air and Kraigg Brathwaite gets under it at wide long off and takes a safe catch. Carlos Brathwaite finally gets the breakthrough. Pretty good knock by Raza comes to an end.
Fuller length ball on off, Ervine mistimes it over mid off for a single.
Slower one outside off, Sikandar punches it away off his back foot for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Raza pushes it to point.
Down the leg side, swept away to fine leg for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
FOUR! Outside off, Raza lofts it confidently over the cover fielder and gets a boundary.
Angles it on the pads, Raza works it down the leg side for a couple.
Fullish and on the pads, quicker one, Raza fails to put his bat on the ball. The umpire turns down the appeal too.
WIDE! Raza gives himself some room and Nurse angles it down the leg side. Raza lets it go through behind him and the umpire signals a wide.
Landed outside off, played towards backward point for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Raza drives it superbly to covers and sets off. Nurse does well to stop the ball there. Single taken.
Fuller length ball outside off, Raza drives it down the ground for a couple.
FOUR! Superb shot! Short of a length ball on middle and off, Raza pulls it over the mid-wicket region. No fielder in the deep there and Sikandar gets a boundary.
Slower one outside off, Raza drives it to covers but the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Short and wide outside off, Ervine punches it through covers for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is back.
Outside off, Raza comes down the track and drills it through covers for a couple.
Angles it on the pads, Raza flicks it to fine leg for a couple.
Slower through the air around off, Raza comes down the track to block.
Fuller length ball on off, Raza drives it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, played through cover for a run.
Landed outside off, Ervine pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Raza slashes it through backward point. The fielder tries to stop there but it goes past him and runs to the fence.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Full around off, Ervine drives it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Good batting! Full and on the pads, Ervine paddles it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Raza gets across and plays the lap shot to the leg side for a single.
Full ball outside off, Raza digs it out to the off side.
Landed outside off, Ervine mistimes his cut towards point.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
5th ODI fifty for Sikandar Raza!
Landed around off, Raza flicks it through square leg and comes back for the second. That brings up his fifty as well.
Flatter on off, Ervine flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Raza drives it straight back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, Ervine plays it through wide mid on and takes a run, the fielder misfields there and the batsmen take an extra run as well.
100-run stand up between Ervine and Raza!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and off, Raza pulls it confidently through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller length ball on off, driven towards mid on by Raza.
Slower through the air around off, Raza covers the line and defends.
Landed outside off, Raza punches it uppishly. The ball falls short of the short cover fielder.
Jonathan Carter comes on to bowl.
Drinks break!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Landed outside off, Ervine guides it to short third man.
Short of a length ball on off, Ervine pulls it through wide mid on for a couple.
Landed around off, Ervine covers the line and blocks.
Landed outside off, Ervine pushes it towards point.
On middle, Raza sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, Raza drives it through mid off for a single.
Big appeal for a leg before! Fuller length ball on off, Raza tries to clip but gets a bit of an inside edge onto his pads. The umpire turns down the appeal and it's a good decision.
FOUR! That's a cracking shot! Short of a length ball on middle and off, Raza rides the bounce and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
9th ODI fifty for Craig Ervine!
Length ball on off, Ervine flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a single to bring up his fifty. Been a fine knock so far.
Fullish ball outside off, Raza drives it through cover-point for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Raza flicks it to square leg.
Pushed quicker through the air by Ashley Nurse, tapped away off the back foot.
That was a ripper of a delivery! It's turning sharply and there's a bit of extra bounce as well. Beats the outside edge by a whisker and goes into Shai Hope's gloves.
Another solid front foot defense offered by the batsman.
Short and wide, turning away from outside off, Ervine rocks back and punches it to cover-point.
Fullish in length, outside off, played off the front foot.
Floats this one up outside off, back of a driving length, Raza gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it down towards wide long off for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Raza comes across, hops and pulls it hard through to deep square leg for one run.
Sharp running that. It's tapped in front of short third man and a quick single is taken.
Good length delivery angled across the left-hander, it's just outside off, Ervine gets big on the ball and taps it down on the off side.
Touch fuller outside off, pushed to the cover region for a run.
Holder brings out the short one and bangs it in hard. It around off and comes back in sharply. Raza sways away and lets the ball sail over him. Nicely done.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Craig Ervine walks across a step and whips it towards mid-wicket with the wrists. Gets a single for doing so.
Jason Holder brings himself back on to have a go with the ball.
Fuller in length and it's dealt with comfortably by Sikandar Raza. That'll be the end of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Waits for this one and plays it late. Camps back and cuts it past point. The placement is so good that the batsmen are able to take three runs.
Spinning away, outside off, keeps a bit low as Ervine looks to cut. Misses and it's taken well by the keeper.
Gives this some decent air and bowls it around the off pole, it's driven to the cover region for no run.
Tossed up and turning away from off, Craig opens the face and defends it a bit square on the off side.
On a length outside off, Sikandar gets a bottom edge as he looks to cut but gets a bottom edge behind to the keeper.
Fuller ball at the base of off stump, it's played back in the direction of the bowler with a straight bat.
Banged in short and outside off, Raza arches back and lets it sail through to the keeper.

Takes the pace off it and bowls a slower one, 108 kph, it's on a fullish length as Raza gets low to this one. Opens the face of the bat in an attempt to steer it to third man but ends up getting a bottom edge right beside him.
Around the wicket now, Gabriel fires in a fuller length ball on the pads, Craig Ervine clips it down towards the fine leg fielder and gets another run to his name.
Angling in on middle and leg, Raza works this through the square leg region and runs to the other end to complete the single.
Flatter outside off, cut away to point.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and clears the infield well. Ervine picked his spot and executed his shot well. He skips down the track and lofts it over mid on to send it all the way.
Fullish from around the wicket, around off, blocked off the front foot into the track ahead.
Extremely full and flat on the stumps, it's drilled down to long on for one.
Over the wicket now to Raza, it's flatter and on a fuller length, some movement in the air as well, defended solidly.
Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, Ervine leans forward and pushes it to long off for a run.
Flicked away through mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Length ball outside off, Ervine lunges forward and defends it into the ground.
WIDE! Way outside off, Ervine leaves it alone. The umpire signals another wide.
Good length ball on off, Ervine defends it off his front foot.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball, Raza tries to push but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flicked away through the leg side for a single.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the bowling attack.
Floats it up outside off, driven back down to long off for one run to end the over.
Flatter and shorter around off, Raza is cramped for room as he looks to cut it away. It goes off the bottom edge and goes past the keeper on the leg side for a single.
Swept away by Sikandar Raza towards fine leg for two good runs.
Ervine was initially going to drive it hard, but then seeing the flight he adjusts and cuts it late down towards third man for three runs.
Tossed up just outside off, it's played in front of short cover.
A slip in place for Ervine now...
Looped up on the stumps, it's driven down to long on on the up for a single.
Back of a length shaping away from around off, Ervine looks to push it on the off side but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! THAT'S HAMMERED! He's played that so well. Shortish from Carlos, Raza picks up the length early and is up for this. He rides the bounce and pulls it hard through backward square leg for a boundary.
50-run stand comes up between Ervine and Raza!
Short ball from Carlos Brathwaite, it's pulled down towards fine leg for one.
Back of a length delivery coming in to the body, it's pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball outside off, cut away square on the off side for nothing.
Carlos Brathwaite has been brought back.
Bowls this slower through the air, it's blocked in front of point.
Looped up on the pads, CE sweeps it behind square on the leg side. Sees the fielder reacting slow and so, the batsmen run hard to come back for the second. This is great batting here.
Full from Ashley Nurse, Ervine gets low to this one and takes it on the full. Paddles it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs. This is good running between the wickets.
Flighted delivery just around off, Ervine plants his front foot forward and wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Full outside off, it's firmly driven through extra cover. A single is taken.

Loopy and turning in from around off, Raza kneels across and attempts to paddle it away but misses. It goes off the pad and rolls away down to fine leg. West Indies appeal for a leg before but it's turned down. They aren't convinced though and decide to take a review against the decision. Replays show that the ball has gone off the glove. But still leg byes are given. Two have been taken.
An lbw decision against Sikandar Raza is reviewed upstairs.
Ashley Nurse will roll his arm now.
Good over this for Zimbabwe. 9 runs have come off it. Raza camps back and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Sensible batting this. Ervine just turns it through square leg and jogs to the other end to get off strike.
Loopy and turning in from around off, Craig Ervine kneels down and reverse sweeps it towards third man for a brace.
Shorter, flatter and outside off, it's cut away square on the off side for another run.
FOUR! Flatter and darted down leg, Raza is up for this one. He adjusts and tickles it fine down the leg side past the keeper for a boundary. Poor delivery, really.
Tossed up on the stumps, Sikandar Raza presses forward and buries it into the track.
Angling in on middle and leg, Raza picks it off his pads and clips it towards backward square leg for a single.
Just around off, Ervine is a little cramped for room as Craig manages to cut it to third man. One run taken.
Back of a length and angled across Craig Ervine, the southpaw punches it off his back foot on the off side for no run.
On a good length, outside off, Sikandar opens the face and dabs it through backward point towards third man for a single.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, Ervine walks across and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Raza opens the face and guides it down to third man for a run.
This full ball is pushed to the covers as well and that will be the end of the over.
Great length from the left-armer, he draws the batsman forward to this. It's eased to the covers for nothing.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Floats this around off, a hint of turn on that as well, it's pushed down to mid off for a brisk single.
Pitches this one up there, good line and it's pitched just back of a driving length, Raza with a solid front foot defense.
On a length and turning away from around off, Sikandar Raza rocks back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Short of a length around off, Craig mistimes the ball and ends up getting a bottom edge on it.
Length delivery just around off, CE gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to play at it.
Makes good use of the wrists and works this one through the gap in the mid-wicket region. The placement is great and it will allow him to pick up a double.
Shaping away from outside off, just back of a length, Craig Ervine looks to timidly push it from inside the line but doesn't make any connection.
Pitches it up there and keeps it outside off, Sikandar Raza drives it towards mid off for one run.
Length ball outside off, it's played towards the point region. No run taken.
Tossed up outside off, not much turn on this one, it's driven through towards sweeper cover for a run.
Pitched just around off, Ervine drags the sweep from outside off and sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Looped up well by Benn, outside off, Raza eases it towards the cover region for one run.
Craig works this on the leg side and gets an easy run for it. Was placed in the gap and done so rather comfortably.

From over the wicket, Benn tosses it up and gets it to turn. It's coming in as Ervine comes forward to push it away. The ball seems to have taken a bit off bat and rolls towards fine leg. West Indies appeal but the umpire turns it down. They do not take the review, Benn looked confident there! Replays show that it went off the gloves. Two runs are taken.
Back of a length on the body, it's pulled down towards fine leg for one run.
Fullish outside off, it's driven towards mid off once more but it's to the fielder this time.

FOUR! Oh, what a shot! Simply beautiful from Craig Ervine. Fuller length ball outside off, the left-hander stands tall to this one and drives it back past mid off with the full face of the bat. Sends it all the way to the boundary line.
Too straight from Brathwaite, it's worked easily on the leg side for one run.

Ervine has found the edge once more. Risky stuff. It's well outside off, Craig Ervine walks down the track and reaches out to this one. Gets a thick outside edge and it flies down to third man for a single.
Fullish length ball around off, kept out off the front foot and into the track.
Full ball from Sulieman Benn, defended off the front foot to end the over.
Some turn here for Been, it's flighted well around off, Raza adjusts and then comfortably deals with it.
Once again it's swept away by the southpaw on the leg side and picks up a single.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot. Tossed up outside off, Ervine leans across and sweeps it through backward square leg to send it all the way.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and fullish in length, around off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Fuller ball around off, Ervine presses forward and keeps it out off the front foot.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Bunts this through the gap in the off side for a single.
Tight line as it's close to the off stump, it's played to point well.
Angles across an excellent length delivery, outside off, Ervine looks to play it inside the line but fails to do so as he is beaten past the outside edge.
Sikandar Raza walks out to bat. Can he stitch a crucial partnership for his side along with Craig Ervine?
Drinks break!

OUT! TAKE A BOW, JASON HOLDER! WHAT A CATCH! Length ball on off, Brain Chari looks to heave it across the line but ends up getting a big top edge. It flies over mid-wicket. Jason Holder is the man there and he is running behind to take this. At first, looking at him, it seems like he won't reach as he's running slow. But to everyone's surprise, he somehow manages to get under the ball. Reaches out and takes it at full stretch diving forward. And in all this, even avoided to clash with the man running in from the deep. Sensational stuff from the Windies skipper.
Works this length ball towards mid-wicket to end the over.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a shorter length and turning a bit from around off, Chari goes back and punches it square through to deep backward point for two runs.

Drifting in on leg, Ervine picks it off his pads and flicks it down towards fine leg. The fielder chases the ball down and keeps it just inside the ropes with a dive. Does well and keeps the batsman to three runs.
Shorter in length and still loopy outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Loopy and coming in on the stumps, it's kept out from within the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Ervine cuts it hard straight to the man at point.
Pitched marginally ahead of a length on the stumps, it's played back to the left of the bowler.
Well bowled. Angles across a length ball, we've seen Ervine struggle with that early on in his innings. He tries to have a poke at it but is beaten past the outside edge.
On a good length and outside off, Brian Chari runs this down to third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chari opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point.
Craig Ervine comes in at 3.

OUT! What has happened here? Confusion in the middle as Chari is caught ball watching. A wicket completely against the run of play. Length ball outside off, Chari taps it behind towards the vacant slip cordon. Hope behind the stumps runs to to the ball and throws it to Brathwaite. During all this, Chibhabha first set off as his partner called for it. But then as Brain was caught ball watching, Chibhabha was left in no man's land. All the time in the world for Carlos to take the bails off. West Indies have their breakthrough.
Carlos Brathwaite is on to bowl now.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Loud appeal from the slip fielder but it's correctly turned down. Not sure why he even appealed there. Sliding on leg, it was always going down further as Chari looked to sweep. Appeal for a leg before not bothered with.
Attacking the stumps on a fullish length here, Chari works it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and full pitched outside off, it's eased down to long off by Chamu Chibhabha.
Floats it up around the off stump, Chibhabha plays it off the inside half back down the track.
Short and wide outside off, it's cut straight to backward point.
Sulieman Benn is brought into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. It will mean 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Full length ball outside off, Chari strides forward and defends it to short cover.
Fullish delivery on middle, clipped to mid on for a brisk single.
Fullish delivery on off, Chamu comes forward and plays it softly towards point. The single is not on there!
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Bowls an overpitched delivery outside off, Chibhabha strides forward and drives it beautifully through mid off. Good timing on that one!
Fuller length ball on off, driven to the covers.
Field change. Short fine leg goes back to fine leg.
Straying on the pads, clipped straight to the man at short fine leg. Chamu wants the single but is sent back.
Slower off cutter on off, Chibhabha pushes it with soft hands down the ground and scurries through for a brisk single.
Short delivery wide outside off, Chibhabha drops his wrists and lets it sail through to the keeper.
On a length angling in on middle and off, Chamu stays back and defends it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on the stumps, Chibhabha strides forward and defends nicely.
Good shot for no runs! Bowls a length delivery outside off, Chamu strides forward and drives it beautifully to extra cover.
On a length around middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Wide! Bowls a short one down the leg side, Chibhabha ducks under it. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Short of a length ball wide outside off, Chari is not bothered to play at that one.
Fullish outside off, pushed to the covers.
THAT'S A PEACH! Bowls it on a length outside off angling in, Chari is across to defend it but the ball shapes away to beat him all ends up.

WELL BOWLED! Bowls it on a length on off, perhaps it holds up on the pitch a bit. Chamu closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge that just lobs over the two fielders in the covers. They take a single. Chibhabha wants the second but is sent back.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Straying on the hips, Chamu tickles it very fine and past short fine leg and the ball rolls through to the boundary.
FOUR! SHOT! Back of a length ball outside off allowing Chibhabha to free his arms. He does so in great style  and thrashes it through cover-point and the ball races to the fence.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chari comes forward and pushes it to the covers.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Wide! Misdirects the bouncer down the leg side this time, Chari ducks under it to evade it.
Slower off cutter outside off at 107 clicks, Chari picks it up as he puts in a confident stride forward and defends it solidly.
That's a well-directed short delivery! Chari ducks underneath it nicely. One bouncer signaled for the over by the umpire.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! half-volley outside off, Chari leans a bit with minimal foot movement and creams it through the covers for a boundary.
Fullish delivery angling down leg, Chari looks to help it on its way but misses. The umpire doesn't call it as a wide!
Short of a length ball outside off, punched solidly to the covers off the back foot.
Straying on the pads, Chamu looks to clip it through but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
GOOD LEAVE! On a length outside off, shapes back in. Chibhabha comes forward, covers his off pole and lets it through.
Short of a length ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single.

WELL BOWLED! On a good length outside off, nipping back in substantially. Chari strides forward to defend but misses the line and is rapped on the pads. An appeal for LBW is turned down. Doesn't take the review as the impact looked well outside off. Hawk Eye confirms the same.
On a length on middle and off, Brian strides forward and defends it down the track.
Shortish delivery angled into the body, Chari rides the bounce and tucks it in front of square for an easy single.
Short of a length on off, Chari hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Field change now. Gully comes in place.
Back of a length delivery on off, Chibhabha drops it on to the track with soft hands and scurries through for a single. Good match awareness.
Length delivery shaping back on off, Chibhabha looks to clip it through but gets it from the inner half to mid on.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot the covers.
THAT'S BEAUTIFULLY BOWLED! Shortish delivery on off, climbing on Chari. He gets into a tangle and fends it through the vacant gully region for a single.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot solidly.
Gets it to curve away this time from a length outside off, some extra bounce as well. Chamu hops back and pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Fullish delivery angling in on middle, Chibhabha plants his front foot across and tickles it fine and the ball races to the fine leg boundary. If he missed that, he would have been a goner!
On a similar line and length, Chibhabha punches it nicely to wide of mid off.
In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, Chamu is no mood to flirt with those.
Short of a length outside off, swings away after pitching. Chibhabha is watchful as he leaves it alone.
That's a peach of a delivery! Bowls a superb yorker at 140 clicks at the base of off stump, Chari is alert to it and digs it out towards short cover.

Shortish delivery outside off, Chamu gets into position quickly and pulls it aerially over mid-wicket. The slow outfield doesn't let the ball run through to the boundary. Good running to come back for three!
Back of a length ball outside off, Brian hangs back and punches it towards point where there is a fumble by the fielder. Concedes the single!
Good call by the umpire to not give it a wide! Bowls it shortish just outside off, nips down sharply. Chari sways away from the line awkwardly.
In between good and full length just outside off, Brian is a bit uncertain as he defends it off his front foot at the last moment.
Fullish delivery angling into middle and leg, Chamu tucks it round the corner for a single.
On a length outside off, Brian strides forward and pushes it to the covers nicely. Steady over by Holder.
Wide! Holder saw him shuffle across his stumps, so bowls it on a leg stump channel looking for the swing back in. But the ball continues on its way down the leg side. Wide signaled by the umpire.
In the corridor of uncertainty, shapes away after pitching. Chari covers the line and taps it to point. Wants the single but is sent back.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven sweetly to the covers but fails to find the gap.
That's a horrible shot! Bowls it back of a length around off, Brian comes down the track and heaves across the line but misses it completely. He needs to apply himself!
Fuller length ball outside off, driven to short cover.
Fullish delivery outside off, swinging away. Chari leans forward and pushes it to cover-point.
Jason Holder to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Shortish and wide asking to be hit, Chibhabha throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Slightly fuller this time outside off at 146 clicks, Chamu comes forward and pushes at it tamely but is beaten all ends up as the ball nipped back. He was also beaten for pace there!
On a length around off, nipping back in. Chari camps back to defend but gets an inside edge to square leg. Single taken and that is the first run of the day.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, shapes back in after pitching. Brian covers his off pole and makes a watchful leave.
Shortish delivery outside off at 144 clicks, gets good carry on that one. Brian points his bat skywards and lets it sail through to the keeper.
Bowls it back of a length on off, Chari camps back and defends it stoutly.
We are all set to get underway. It will be Brian Chari and Chamu Chibhabha to open the innings for the hosts. And it will be Shannon Gabriel to start things off for the Windies. Let's go...
Both teams are out now for their respective National Anthems.

Pitch Report - It's quite damp coming through the outfield. The pitch has a coldness about it, it feels like the covers have just come off. A little bit damp but it's petty hard. Could seam around early on and it could become good for batting later on. Now, as history has suggested, 60% of matches that have been played here, the team batting second has won. So, if you win the toss, you're going to want to bowl first, reckons Pat Symcox.

JASON HOLDER says he wanted to bowl first as it will move around a bit early. Also says he has a group that has come out fresh and are looking forward to it. Chuckles as he states that they lost the toss in the previous match but still managed to win it. Ends saying that they have the same squad.

GRAEME CREMER says they will have a bat first. Adds that the wicket looks a bit rough so they'll look to use that and bowl later on. (On this being the 200th ODI in Zimbabwe) Says it is quite special and that he just found out today, so is looking forward to it. Mentions that it might swing but not quite off the deck, but after that first hour it will get easier. On team changes, he briefs that Chisoro comes in for Mumba and Mpofu replaces Panyangara.
ZIMBABWE WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

Hello and a warm welcome for the 3rd ODI between Zimbabwe and West Indies in Bulawayo. The home side suffered a thumping defeat at the hands of Sri Lanka in the opener and they quickly need to get their act together. It will come down to their temperament on how they handle a raging Windies side. West Indies didn't put a foot wrong in their previous encounter against the Lankans and would look to stamp their authority on this one too. The hosts would look to turn the tide against the table toppers and take them by surprise.
